title: Family Travel in Costa Rica: The Ultimate 2026 Guide
metaDescription: Plan the perfect family trip to Costa Rica. Kid-friendly activities, family accommodations, and tips for stress-free travel with children.
excerpt: Costa Rica is a fantastic destination for families. From kid-friendly attractions to comfortable accommodations, this guide has everything you need.
author: Travel Editors
content:
Costa Rica offers a perfect blend of adventure and relaxation. If you are traveling with family to Costa Rica, you will find endless opportunities to create unforgettable memories.

## Kid-Friendly Activities

- Interactive museums and cultural centers that engage children of all ages
- Outdoor adventures like parks, beaches, and nature reserves perfect for burning energy
- Animal encounters and wildlife experiences that educate and entertain
- Hands-on workshops where kids can learn local crafts and traditions

![Family travel in Costa Rica](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1620658927695-c33df6fb8130?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Family Accommodation Tips

Look for family rooms or connecting rooms in Costa Rica to keep everyone together while maintaining some privacy.

## Packing for Kids

- Pack snacks and entertainment for transit times
- Bring comfortable walking shoes for everyone
- Carry a small first-aid kit with familiar medications
- Pack light but include comfort items from home
